explication: Stockfish is a UCI chess engine: a GUI or other client sends position and search commands, and receives analysis and best-move output. The runtime sets up the board, searches candidate moves, evaluates positions, and returns results. Search uses move generation, shared search state, and optional Syzygy tablebases; evaluation uses NNUE features and network inference. The README documents UCI operation and NNUE evaluation; source excerpts are partial, so some subsystem wiring is shown only where supported by the tree and excerpts.
